text: Hi, I am Deepa Shenoy, and this is my week two progress update with Humanitarian's AI. This is Liam narrating for Deepa. My focus was getting the existing Brutalist workflow running locally on my Mac, so I could move from setting up tools to making videos. I downloaded and extracted the Brutalist.art repository, then reviewed its folders and the available video builders. I checked Python, Git, and Node, then created a Python 3.12 virtual environment and installed the required Python dependencies. The Manim setup needed additional dependencies. I resolved that issue by installing Pango and Package Config. I also installed and configured OpenAI Codex as the coding agent I would use with the project. To

Check the setup, I ran {dot} {slash} art {dash} {dash} list and confirmed the available builders. The local environment was working and ready for production. With the environment working, I was ready to move from setup into creating and reviewing my first Brutalist videos. Setting up my Brutalist film as code environment. This is Liam narrating for Deepa for Humanitarian's AI.
